summary: Require Go 1.26.6 or newer to avoid reachable standard-library vulnerabilities.
reason: A scan of the 1.26.5 directive found four reachable vulnerabilities (GO-2026-6218, GO-2026-6090, GO-2026-5972, GO-2026-5026) fixed in Go 1.26.6; 1.26.6 is also the toolchain the library's govulncheck CI runs with GOTOOLCHAIN=local.
